An older eligibility excerpt records https://example.invalid/garden/earlier, checked 12 September 2026. The current fictional source register records https://example.invalid/garden/current, checked 30 September 2026. This mismatch is deliberate: preserve the earlier wording and review it before reuse. No website was opened or verified.

Earlier-round answers, dates and actions are historical practice records. That round is recorded closed. No application or enquiry was sent. Keep those records for reference without using them as current work.
